title: Blueberry Granita with Lemon Zest
changes_from_base: Blueberries and lemon zest replace the strawberries.
summary: A refreshing violet ice treat made with fresh blueberries and bright citrus notes for a crisp finish.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Place 450 g blueberries, 180 ml water, 90 g caster sugar, 60 ml lemon juice and a pinch of fine salt in the blender. Process on high speed until the mixture is very smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Sieve the purée straight into a 33 x 23 cm glass dish. Press down on the skins to get all the juice through, then stir in 1 tsp lemon zest.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Place the dish uncovered in the freezer for about 1 h until the edges begin to set.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Use a fork to scrape the frozen edges and stir them into the centre of the dish.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Continue to scrape and stir the mixture every 30-60 min for 2-3 h to create icy crystals.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fork the deep violet ice once more to fluff it up. Spoon the granita into chilled glasses and serve immediately.

tips: Use fresh or thawed frozen blueberries depending on what is available.
Ensure the glass dish is the correct size to help the mixture freeze evenly.
Chill your serving glasses in advance to prevent the ice from melting too quickly.
storage: Keep the granita covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to break up the crystals before serving.
